channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Visual & Media Arts, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Visual & Media Arts, Canada, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:

  • Grantham Foundation: Creation Residency in Visual Arts 2026 (Quebec)
    Fondation Grantham pour l'art et l'environnement · deadline Closed 27 May 2026 · CAD $5,000 to $10,000 grant plus a four-week residency (accommodation and studio provided). No application fee.
